title: B2B Multi-Tenant Isolation (RLS)
validation_check: PostgreSQL RLS blocks cross-tenant queries at driver level

database_schema.tenant_table: Central tenant management with UUID primary key
database_schema.tenant_columns: Added to all Phase 2 tables (entities, snapshots, deltas, audit_entries, orders, positions, trades, strategies, signals)
database_schema.migration: Handles existing data with default tenant

row_level_security.insert_policies: WITH CHECK ensures tenant_id matches context
row_level_security.delete_policies: Only own data deletable (audit entries protected)

session_management.tenant_manager: Async context manager with connection pooling

security_safeguards.middleware: FastAPI middleware extracts tenant from JWT/subdomain
security_safeguards.delete_block: Audit entries cannot be deleted (EU AI Act)

leak_test.no_context: ✓ No data returned without tenant context
leak_test.bypass_attempt: ✓ Cannot bypass RLS with tenant_id filter

integration_points.phase2_tables: All HSTR, PTP, DeltaLag, ZK-Audit tables now multi-tenant
integration_points.api_gateway: Tenant extracted from JWT/subdomain before database
integration_points.compliance: EU AI Act audit trail maintained per tenant

security_features.database_level: RLS policies enforce isolation at PostgreSQL level
